services.name: St. Pete Bi-Plane Ride - 30 minutes
services.desc: $275 per person 30 minutes About This flight provides a scenic view of the beautiful beaches. You will fly to Fort Desoto before turning North to follow the beach past St Pete Beach and Treasure Island, to John's Pass. $275 per person. Video package is available for an additional $35 Aerobatic Flight Upgrade available for $75! Loops, barrel-rolls and wing-overs will put some real adventure in your life. See the beach upside down...makes for a great video! 10% deposit due at check-out. TO BOOK, PLEASE CALL $275 per person
